answer.reason: JDG 3:31 states Shamgar's deed and that he delivered Israel, which the summary does not say beyond his parentage.

clauses.english: slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and delivered Israel
clauses.quote: slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad

doubts: JDG 5:6 only dates the time of Shamgar and Jael by the unsafe highways, so it was left out.
